steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Oh, Fiammetta... Hm? Seems like you're in a bit of a mess.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: None of your business.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: No need to get worked up. Care to sit down for a cup of tea?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Enough of your jokes. Why are you here? Mostima never mentioned you were our support.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Well, Velliv didn't give me an official order either.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: And personally, I'm more than willing to help, yeah?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Mostima says there's another group after the little girl, and you've already run into them. Is that right?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: More or less.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: After I heard from the Notarial Hall that Ezell cut his signal, I figured you might get intercepted. If you were to get caught out by the enemy, we'd end up losing the girl, no?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I don't know why Mostima isn't here to help you, but if she's pinned down, I figure I'll be doing her a favor.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: After all, it's not every day I get the opportunity to have the two of you in my debt.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: A few hopeless stragglers can't stop me.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: 'A cautious crew sails for ten thousand years,' Fiammetta. Velliv's going to have a hold over you at this rate.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Oh, that's a Yanese proverb. In other words, safety is born of caution.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Stop trying to show off, Oren. You're so annoying when you talk like that.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I'm not kidding. I at least got to express my goodwill. The rest is up to you.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Or, do you perhaps need me to escort you, my sweet Fiammetta?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: No need. Goodbye, Oren.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Executor Ezell, hand over the girl.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: It is in your best interest to comply.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Your name is Fiammetta, right? Seniora Fiammetta, I have a request.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Let's hear it then.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: No sudden movements. There's no telling how I might react.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I know it was suspicious of me to go against Richele's orders and turn off my terminal, but...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Believe me, I haven't betrayed Laterano.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: The reason I didn't follow the Hall's exact orders was because I didn't want anything to happen to Cecelia... And, I made a promise to her.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: And how is that my problem?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Please just let me accompany you to the Basilica with Cecelia. If the Lateran Curia wants an explanation for this situation, wouldn't it be more convenient to have me around?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You're getting ahead of yourself. If you think you'll be able to influence how the Curia will handle this situation–– You'll want to disabuse yourself of that.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Going one step further... If you're thinking you could take the girl away if you don't like what the Lateran Curia plans to do with her...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Not gonna happen. Not in your wildest dreams.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I wouldn't dare. I'm well aware of the Basilica's Gun-Knights.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I am a Lateran executor, after all. I was concerned before because I didn't know what was happening with Cecelia, or exactly who was after her...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Now that I understand, I will comply with your arrangements.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Um... Your name is Cecelia? Can you walk?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Ezell...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia, I can carry you, if you're too tired.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'll carry her. You're too slow.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: (*whispers*) Mister Ezell, I...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Don't worry. Everything will be okay.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Executor Ezell Pastore went to 7-265 Via Thervatius in Pagus Stevonus this morning to verify an identity, record a will, and retrieve a patron firearm.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Around noon, Ezell appeared in Stevonus Central Hospital, taking in an eight-year-old Sankta girl and departing in an unusual manner.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The resident of 7-265 Via Thervatius, Pagus Stevonus, Feoria La Porta, died of illness this morning and the body was moved to the Ecclesia Requietum.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Only one individual is registered to 7-265 Via Thervatius, and the census pagus also records only one individual residing there.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: An investigation of twenty years of maintenance records at 7-265 Via Thervatius revealed that a basement had been added seven years ago, with contractor documents indicating that the space would be for storage.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: This is a file photo of Feoria La Porta and surveillance footage of the girl that Ezell took to the hospital.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: You must've already reached a conclusion about where the girl came from.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Additionally, according to the report submitted by Ezell this morning, Feoria La Porta did not leave a will or an advance directive. The reason is quite clear: she hoped to avoid contact with the Notarial Hall.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: It is reasonable to infer that Feoria La Porta knew her time was short and sought to secure a future for her daughter.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: It is currently impossible to determine whether Ezell is the object of Feoria La Porta's entrustment, but based on Ezell's background, the probability is low.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Combined with the information sent back by Fiammetta, the more likely trustee should be...

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Astray.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Mostima, is this the reason you stayed behind in the Basilica?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Just temporarily.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Don't be so uptight, Vel. Cream puff?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Phew. Luckily, we went for the more conservative option.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: It would've been awkward if Fiammetta walked in on me getting rid of the Notarial Hall's men.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Enough of your excuses. I'd avoid saying too much to that executor, if I were you. Cecelia's already on the Guide's side.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: That's just one executor, Patia. Things haven't gotten so out of hand that I need to get personally involved.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Plus, I think that executor's concerns are simple enough. He found the pity within him to cause his heart to waver, and couldn't bear to see a sweet little girl suffer.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Now that we understand him, it's only a matter of time until he comes over, no violence necessary.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: If only Fiammetta hadn't shown up so soon...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: That is to say it's your fault for not stopping Fiammetta, Patia.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Just kidding.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: But, I do take pity on that one's luck. What was a little old thing is now very complicated... That's what happens when you get ahead of yourself.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Is this, too, a trial given to us by the great and mighty Lateran?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Are you a believer again?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: A true believer wouldn't say something like that. Those sorts, who treat hardships as trials, they turn it all into... a blessing from fate?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: There are quite a lot of believers like that around the two of you, aren't there?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I'd take them over self-serving Sankta like you any day.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: So, what's the plan now? Once Cecelia gets to the Basilica, is she going to come out again? Do we have some way to take her?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: One step at a time, Patia. If we're talking about not wanting Cecelia to step foot in the Basilica, I'm even less inclined than you.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: But, we haven't played all our cards, have we?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Go tail Fiammetta, but not too closely.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I've got plenty on my plate. Just found out that someone's looking for me too. Popularity isn't all it's made out to be, you know.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Don't go inviting trouble for me.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Alright, looks like the next clue of the chain is clear. What do you plan to do?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I will go to him.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Even though I have no doubts about your, uh, strength... you're dealing with a well-connected Legatus. It'll look pretty bad if you make something out of nothing.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: He is involved in this incident.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: We have to look into this precisely because he's involved, right? Sometimes, I envy the way you see things.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: But what if he doesn't know anything?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I need to investigate to be clear.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: That's true. In any case, the fact that a Legatus is involved at all warrants looking into.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: What I didn't expect is that Feoria, an ordinary and reclusive Sankta, would provide us with so many leads. An undocumented girl, a Legatus...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: And... a Sarkaz.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Hmm, you're leaving? Not even going to say goodbye?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Well, alright then...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Now that you're gone...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Don't blame me, Oren. I can't stop Federico.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I'll put in a report for you. That's about all I can do.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: She's asleep.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: She's exhausted.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You mentioned that you made her a promise. What was it?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: That I'd help her find her mother.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Her mother? Wait, didn't Mostima say in the message that her mother is...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Yes, dead. Saw the body with my own eyes in the back of the Ecclesia Requietum's hearse.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Then, why'd you promise her that?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I didn't know, at the time.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: And then? Did you tell her?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I did. But at her age, I'm not sure she understands the concepts of 'passing on' or 'death.'

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Must've been tough for you.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: And... don't look so upset. I don't think the Pope... will treat the girl too harshly.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Her name is Cecelia.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Seniora Fiammetta...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Just Fiammetta is fine.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Miss Fiammetta... I was thinking, after Cecelia goes to the Basilica, will she ever come out again...?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I can't promise you anything. But the way I see things, all else aside, she has a halo. That makes her a Sankta.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: And when dealing with a Sankta, all must obey the Commandments, be it the Lateran Curia or the Notarial Hall. At least that's what I believe.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Even if she's undocumented.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Uhh... is that really the main issue?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Who knows? Might be possible to get her registered retroactively.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: But, there's... something wrong with Cecelia's halo.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I'm not entirely sure how serious this whole mixed-blood Sankta issue gets... But at least the Legatus implied that Cecelia would be fine.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: A lot of foreign envoys have been gathering in Laterano lately, right?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: His Holiness has been preparing a major summit... I can't help but worry that Cecelia will be a target for someone trying to stir up trouble.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Sounds like you've really thought this one through.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Coming from the other angle, what would the Lateran Curia do to prevent that from happening?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Miss Fiammetta, I don't know if I should even be thinking about these things.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: But I can't just not think.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You'll have to pardon me for being blunt.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: But what's the point of worrying about all this? Is there any part of it you can actually control?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: If you know that Cecelia is in danger, then you should also understand that for Cecelia, the Basilica is the safest place.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Nngh...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Sorry, I fell asleep...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Did we wake you?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: N-No, I just...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Ezell, is that your stomach growling?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Want me to buy you a donut, Cecelia?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: D-Donut? Okay! Thank you, Mister Ezell...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll go for it. I need a break, my arms are sore from carrying her around.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: (*whispers*) There's no way I can handle her long-term, alright?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: But don't do anything stupid, Ezell. I've got my eye on you.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: You still don't trust me?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Oh, and turn on your terminal. You're not allowed to have it off.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Yeah, I know.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: (*whispers*) Mister Ezell, that lady was so mean to you before... I'm scared.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Don't worry, Cecelia. She's not a bad person.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister Ezell... can't I go see Mamma? Can't I even say goodbye to her?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Um... Well, we need to take you somewhere else first, so you can be safe.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: As for your mama... I'll tell you about her later. Let me... think about it first. Is that okay, Cecelia?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Do you hear that?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Hear what?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Someone is singing...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Let's see... Oh, you're right! It seems to be coming from that cotton candy cart... But I'm surprised you could hear it with all the noise on the street. You have really good hearing, Cecelia.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: It's because I recognize that song!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma taught it to me!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Um... I can't go off on my own, right?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: It's okay. We can't go over there, but I can get the cotton candy cart to come over here.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Excuse me––

steps.name: Serene Peddler
steps.text: Is someone calling us?

steps.name: Merry Peddler
steps.text: Hum hum hum~♪

steps.name: Serene Peddler
steps.text: You really like that song, don't you...? Hey, there really is someone hailing us. Let's head over there. If we can't get any info, let's at least make some money.

steps.name: Merry Peddler
steps.text: All~ righty~♪

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Hello...

steps.name: Merry Peddler
steps.text: Oh hello, little girl, would you like some cotton candy?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: We'll get two, or actually, three sticks. This flavor here, this one here, and then the swirl. Is that alright?

steps.name: Merry Peddler
steps.text: No problem.

steps.name: Serene Peddler
steps.text: Three sticks, coming right up.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Um, excuse me... What's the name of that song you were singing earlier?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma taught me the same song, but never told me what it's called...

steps.name: Merry Peddler
steps.text: Huh? Your mama... taught you this song?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Um, excuse me, the cotton candy! The cotton candy is coming out!

steps.name: Merry Peddler
steps.text: Ahh, I'm so very sorry, just give me a moment––

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Hold on, the compartment's about to overflow! Let me help you...

steps.name: Merry Peddler
steps.text: Sorry, sorry!

steps.name: Serene Peddler
steps.text: (*whispers*) Your hat!!! Your hat's caught!

steps.name: Merry Peddler
steps.text: *rip*––

steps.name: Serene Peddler
steps.text: W-Wait, don't get the wrong idea, she's a Caprinae...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Miss!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Your horns look just like Papà's...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Are you also a Sarkaz?

steps.name: Serene Peddler
steps.text: (*whispers*) Put it back on!!

steps.name: Merry Peddler
steps.text: I, no, I'm... Little missy, you, you've got it all wrong...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: A Sarkaz infiltrating Laterano... Are you also after Cecelia?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What happened, Ezell?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Miss Fiammetta, this particular individual... is a Sarkaz.
But there's another sentence that I dare not say.

steps.name: Serene Peddler
steps.text: Tch... Guess we have no choice, now that it's come to this...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You've got guts, I'll give you that...
